scripts.test: npm run build && playwright test --project=chromium && npm run test:webkit
scripts.test:webkit: cd ../.. && podman run --rm --network host --ipc host --security-opt label=disable -v "$PWD":/work -w /work/tests/e2e mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble npx playwright test --project=webkit
